the_central_finding.statement: The coefficient is LARGEST where the evidence is weakest and smallest where it looks strongest. At 12 months the point estimate is 1.297; at 36 months it is 0.757. But the clustered t runs 1.63, 1.46, 7.07 across 12, 24 and 36 months.
the_central_finding.why_this_matters: The 36-month t-statistic of 7.07 is computed on five clusters whose return windows overlap by two years each, giving T_eff 1.67. Overlapping windows make cluster residuals resemble one another, which understates the standard error; the apparent precision is largely a property of the overlap, not of the evidence. The 12-month horizon is the only one whose per-origin observations are genuinely independent, and there the same effect carries t 1.63.
the_central_finding.what_did_not_collapse: Direction survives everywhere. The pooled coefficient is positive at all three horizons, per-origin signs are 4/5 or better at all three, rank IC means are positive at all three, the B/P-stratified spread is positive at 4/5 or better at all three, and the Fama-MacBeth t exceeds 2 at both 12 and 24 months.
the_central_finding.what_did_collapse: Conventional statistical significance of the pooled estimate, once windows stop overlapping.
the_central_finding.the_weak_origin: 2021 is negative at 12 months on all three readings — coefficient -1.926, rank IC -0.018, spread -0.044. That origin's 12-month window is July 2021 to June 2022, the growth drawdown. High-ICC (cheap) names did worse over exactly that year.

verdict.label: G3_HORIZON_SPECIFIC

condition_by_condition.b_12m_pooled_positive_with_clustered_t_a: FAILED — sign is 4/5, but clustered t is 1.634, below the frozen bound of 2

verdict.mapping: The frozen rules define G3_HORIZON_SPECIFIC as exactly this case: pooled coefficient positive at 36 months while condition (b) fails at 12. G3_FAIL is not triggered — no horizon carries a negative pooled coefficient, let alone a significant one.
verdict.no_rescue_was_attempted: The Fama-MacBeth t at 12 months is 2.173 and would clear a threshold of 2. It is not the quantity condition (b) names. The condition says pooled coefficient with clustered t, and it was frozen in an earlier commit specifically so that a second statistic could not be substituted after the fact.
verdict.evidence_class: SUPPORTED_NOT_VALIDATED, and this gate narrows what the support means: the lens's direction is stable across horizons, its statistical significance is not.

consequences_for_the_release_gate.mandate_section_17: RELEASE_RESEARCH_BETA requires 'G3 stable/consistent'. G3 returned HORIZON_SPECIFIC, so that condition is not met on the evidence as it stands.
consequences_for_the_release_gate.current_path: KEEP_INTERNAL_SHADOW is the live candidate: G0, G1 and G2 passed, G3 is horizon-specific, and G4 has not run.
consequences_for_the_release_gate.not_a_retirement_signal: RETIRE_ICC_LENS requires basis dependence, forecast-strip collapse, leakage or placebo failure, inconsistent directions, or a survivor-only artifact. None of those occurred. Direction is consistent at every horizon.
consequences_for_the_release_gate.what_would_change_it: More non-overlapping origins. Five annual origins is the binding constraint, not the model. This is the same limitation the recovery mission recorded on 2026-08-07 and it has not moved.
consequences_for_the_release_gate.owner_gate_unchanged: Any public release of the ICC lens requires explicit owner approval; the public surface remains quarantined.
